responsibility: Declares the call_details helper used to model a specific GIMPLE call with its current analyzer state. It packages the call statement, region_model, optional region_model_context, resolved lhs storage, and argument/query helpers so known_function implementations can read arguments, write results, inspect types, and obtain conjured return values without directly manipulating raw GIMPLE and region-model plumbing.
same_name_distinction: Declares the call_details adapter class and its query/update API for modeling one call site. Unlike call-details.cc, it is the interface definition consumed by known-function models, not the code that performs those queries and helper operations.
